description: Explore the great outdoors with confidence, thanks to Rothco’s Canvas Outdoorsman Rucksack. This rugged, heavy-duty backpack is designed to securely carry all your essential gear during outdoor adventures. The spacious main compartment offers ample room for larger items and is secured with a drawstring closure, topped with a pocket lid featuring an adjustable buckle closure for added security. A zippered compartment on the pocket lid provides convenient access to smaller items, while the front zippered pocket ensures quick access to personal necessities. Side pockets with buckle closures offer extra storage for water bottles or other gear. Equipped with multiple D-rings, the rucksack allows for additional gear attachment, making it ideal for extended treks. The adjustable padded shoulder straps and 2-inch waist belt provide a comfortable, secure fit, while the durable cotton canvas construction ensures long-lasting use in rugged conditions. Complete with a top carry handle for easy transport, this rucksack is perfect for camping, hiking, or any outdoor adventure. Made from Rothco’s durable heavyweight canvas fabric, this superior material is naturally water-resistant, rugged, and is built for the long haul. No one comes close to Rothco’s collection of ultra-premium canvas bags and packs.
